3. Place a centered text box across the top strip; text exactly 'Less Than Equal Constraints'; bold, red (#C00000), largest type on the slide.
4. Top-right corner, level with the title: yellow (#FFD966) rounded pill badge containing exactly '6' (number color unspecified — use black).
5. Below the title, draw one white rectangle with a thin red (#C00000) border spanning nearly the full width, from under the title to just above the bottom black band — this is the content panel.
6. Split the panel into three equal stacked section boxes using red horizontal border lines: Box 1 (top), Box 2 (middle), Box 3 (bottom); each keeps white fill and red border.

8. Box 1, upper area: red bold line exactly 'x₁ ≤ z₁,  x₂ ≤ z₂,  x₃ ≤ z₃' followed by a green (#00B050) bold '⟹' leading into the next line.
9. Box 1, below step 8: matrix equation exactly '[1 0 0; 0 1 0; 0 0 1] [x₁; x₂; x₃] ≤ [z₁; z₂; z₃]' rendered as bracketed arrays (3×3 identity matrix, two 3×1 vectors); matrix and x-vector black, RHS z-vector blue (#0070C0).

11. Box 2, top-left: label exactly 'Greater-than converted' in red.
12. Box 2, upper area: red bold line exactly 'x₁ ≥ z₁,  x₂ ≥ z₂,  x₃ ≥ z₃' followed by a green '⟹'.
13. Box 2, below step 12: matrix equation exactly '[−1 0 0; 0 −1 0; 0 0 −1] [x₁; x₂; x₃] ≤ [−z₁; −z₂; −z₃]'; matrices black, RHS vector blue (#0070C0).
14. Box 2, right side: pale-yellow (#FFF2CC) rounded panel containing four stacked lines: 'Convert' (red, italic, heading), then 'x₁ ≥ z₁, x₂ ≥ z₂, x₃ ≥ z₃', then 'to', then '−x₁ ≤ −z₁, −x₂ ≤ −z₂, −x₃ ≤ −z₃' (body color unspecified — use black).
15. Box 3, top-left: label exactly '6 constraints, 3 variables' in red.
16. Box 3, upper area: red bold line exactly 'y₁ ≤ x₁ ≤ z₁,  y₂ ≤ x₂ ≤ z₂,  y₃ ≤ x₃ ≤ z₃' followed by a green '⟹'.
17. Box 3, below step 16: 6×3 matrix equation exactly '[−1 0 0; 0 −1 0; 0 0 −1; 1 0 0; 0 1 0; 0 0 1] [x₁; x₂; x₃] ≤ [−y₁; −y₂; −y₃; z₁; z₂; z₃]' in black (RHS color unspecified), with a small red '6×3' annotation beside/beneath the matrix (source shows it under a brace).
18. Box 3, right side: pink (#F8CBAD) rounded rectangle callout with red bold text exactly 'Gx ≤ h', the 'x' underlined.
